name: drawer
summary: A modal <dialog> that slides up from the bottom with a handle, and closes when dragged down. A bottom Sheet for phones: the runtime adds the drag; without it, Escape, the backdrop and Drawer.Close still close it.
use: A short form or a choice on a phone
Details of a list row on small screens

avoid.case: A panel beside a list on large screens

enhances.fallback: no drag; it closes with Escape, the backdrop or Drawer.Close

parts.description: The <dialog>, along the bottom edge, with a handle above the title. Drag the handle or the title down to close it.

id.description: Required. Triggers and close buttons reference it.

dismissible.description: none also turns off closing by drag.

parts.description: A Button that opens the drawer.

drawer.description: Id of the drawer to open.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

parts.description: A Button that closes the drawer.

drawer.description: Id of the drawer to close.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

keyboard.Tab: moves focus within the drawer only

rules: The handle is decorative: give every drawer a visible way to close it (a Drawer.Close, or an action that closes it).
Every trigger and close button references an existing Drawer id.

examples.title: Add an event
examples.code:
<Drawer.Trigger drawer="add-event" variant="primary">予定を追加</Drawer.Trigger>
<Drawer id="add-event" title="予定を追加">
  <Field label="題名"><Input /></Field>
  <Drawer.Close drawer="add-event">やめる</Drawer.Close>
</Drawer>
